title: Kosh Functional & Design Report
description: Schema for the kosh functional and design report: layout, content, links, images, contrast, metadata and mobile behaviour across several pages of a WordPress site. Each page's inventory (headings, links, images, share tags) in inventory[] and the off-site link results in linkChecks[] come from the browser's page capture and kosh's link checker, not from the model. Renders through the standard QA renderer in scripts/generate-report.js.

url.description: The site URL the test was asked to run against.

websiteName.description: The site's name, from its title or og:site_name.

timestamp.description: When the run's browser first loaded a page, from the page capture. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh, which replaces any value written here when the capture has a visit.

provenance.description: What produced this report, so runs can be compared across plugin versions, skill edits, and models.

model.description: Exact model ID the run was served by. For a skill's own output on Claude Code, read from the session log by scripts/run-qa-report.sh; elsewhere self-reported by the model, "unknown" when its system prompt does not state one. The only provenance field the skill writes.

modelSource.description: Where model came from: "transcript" is Claude Code's session log (the model that served the run's latest reply), "self-report" is the skill's own claim, used when there is no session log and when the report is re-rendered. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

effort.description: The reasoning effort the run's latest reply was sent at, from Claude Code's session log or its CLAUDE_EFFORT variable; absent on hosts that set neither. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

pluginVersion.description: kosh version from .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

skills.description: SHA-256 of each skill directory that produced the report, keyed by skill name. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

collectors.description: SHA-256 of the collectors/ directory, the page-side code Playwright MCP loads into every page, as it was on disk when the report was rendered. A session started before collectors/ changed ran the older code. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

playwrightMcp.description: The Playwright MCP arguments (the pinned version and its flags) in kosh's plugin.json when the report was rendered. A session started before plugin.json changed ran with the older ones. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

captureSha256.description: SHA-256 of the page capture archived beside the report as <name>.capture.jsonl, which a functional report's inventory[] is built from. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

heldTo.description: The host the run's browser was held to once the gate check came back clear, from the page capture: after that, a page on another host or the model's own request to one was refused. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

seal.description: SHA-256 over the report timestamp, pluginVersion, skills, collectors, playwrightMcp, captureSha256, model, modelSource, effort and heldTo, marking the block as script-stamped for this run. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

environment.description: Environment the site was running in during the test. Defaults to production.

testMethodology.description: A few sentences on how the run went: the pages and why, the viewports, and anything that changes how the findings read, such as an inferred environment.

visitedPages.description: URLs of every page the test covered. Each must have a captured visit in inventory[], or the report is refused.

inventory.description: One row per page and viewport, as it first loaded. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh from the browser's record — do not write this field.

linkChecks.description: kosh's link checker's result for each off-site link checked this run. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh from the link checker's record — do not write this field.

explorationPass.description: Threads investigated beyond the checks, recorded whatever the outcome, so an observation outside this test's scope survives here instead of becoming a finding. Findings themselves live in `issues`.

check.description: What was examined, specific enough for someone else to repeat it.

outcome.description: no-issue = investigated and fine. finding-raised = became an entry in `issues`. inconclusive = cannot be settled without access not available during the run. out-of-scope = a real problem outside performance, in which case set `referredTo`.

detail.description: What was actually observed, including the evidence. For inconclusive outcomes, say what would settle it. For finding-raised, name the finding.

area.description: Surface this relates to, e.g. Images, Fonts, Scripts. Free text.

referredTo.description: For out-of-scope outcomes, the kosh test that covers this territory, e.g. a11y or functional-design.

openQuestions.description: Things seen that might be problems but that this run could not settle, kept apart from the findings and their counts.

seen.description: What was observed, specifically enough to find it again.

why.description: Why it is uncertain: what the run could not see, reach or confirm.

wouldSettle.description: What would settle it, and who could: the client, the developer, an editor login, a check on another environment.

webUrl.description: An http(s) URL of a page kosh navigated to. URLs observed on the site, such as a failed request's, are plain strings: a malformed one is something to report, not to fix in the JSON.

id.description: A stable ID within this report, F-01 onwards in the order the findings are listed. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

category.description: Design = layout, spacing, typography, visual consistency, image quality. Links = broken or wrong destinations, icon mismatches. Content = spelling, grammar, placeholder or unpublishable content. Metadata = share tags, titles, descriptions, icons. Functionality = something that doesn't work: a form, a menu, a template rendering twice. Mobile = what breaks only at a small viewport. UX = confusing navigation, unclear calls to action. Accessibility = contrast, and other accessibility observations, which the renderer points at the accessibility test.

issue.description: What is wrong, naming the markup, block, template or asset that causes it.

impact.description: How this affects visitors or the site owner.

fix.description: What to change, specifically enough to act on without re-running the test.

fixAt.description: Where the fix goes, when the run could tell. A file only when the folder the run started in holds the site's code: the report is refused if that file, or that line, isn't there.

kind.description: file = a file in the folder the run started in. content = a page, post, media item or menu edited in the WordPress editor. setting = a WordPress or block setting. plugin = a plugin's configuration or code. host = the hosting or CDN.

path.description: For kind file: the path relative to the folder the run started in.

line.description: For kind file: the line, if one is known.

detail.description: What to change there: the setting's name and screen, the plugin, the selector or function.

wcag.description: Only for contrast: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) for text, 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast for UI components. No other criterion, since contrast is the only one this test measures.

device.description: Which viewport the issue was observed on.

pages.description: URLs where the issue was observed.

screenshots.description: Paths relative to the kosh-reports/ directory, e.g. 'screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png' for a file saved at kosh-reports/screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png.

notRead.description: The page loaded but its inventory couldn't be read.

counts.description: How many there were in all; the lists below stop at 100 headings, 300 links and 150 images.

redirectedTo.description: The origin it ended on when that is another site; a long host name is cut to its end.

pathChanged.description: It ended on a different page, such as a login or error page.
